en: The Thousand Names of Śrī Āñjaneya. Oṃ, obeisance to Hanumān. Oṃ, obeisance to the Bestower of Prosperity.
Oṃ, homage to the son of Vāyu.
Oṃ, homage to Rudra.
Oṃ, homage to the sinless one.
Oṃ, homage to the Ageless One. Oṃ, homage to the Immortal Hero among Heroes. Oṃ, homage to the Dweller in the Village.
Oṃ, homage to the refuge of people!
Oṃ, homage to the giver of wealth!
Oṃ, homage to the one beyond qualities!
Oṃ, homage to the Hero.
Oṃ, homage to the Valiant One. Oṃ, homage to the Sage, the Lord of Treasures.
Oṃ, homage to Piṅgākṣa.
Oṃ, homage to Varada.
Oṃ, homage to Vāgmī, the destroyer of Sītā’s sorrow.
Oṃ, homage to Śiva.
Oṃ, homage to Śarva.
Oṃ, homage to Para.
Oṃ, salutation to the Unmanifest.
Oṃ, salutation to the Manifest-Unmanifest.
Oṃ, salutation to the Supporter of the Earth.
Oṃ, homage to the one with tawny hair. Oṃ, homage to the one with tawny body-hair, who is accessible through sacred revelation.
Oṃ, homage to the eternal one.
Oṃ, homage to the beginningless Blessed One.
Oṃ, homage to the God.
Oṃ, homage to the cause of the universe, who is without support.
Oṃ, salutation to Viśveśa, the bestower of health.
Oṃ, salutation to Viśvanātha.
Oṃ, salutation to Harīśvara.
Oṃ, obeisance to Bharga.
Oṃ, obeisance to Rāma. Oṃ, obeisance to the devotee of Rāma.
Oṃ, homage to Kalyāṇa. Oṃ, homage to Prakṛtisthira.
Oṃ, homage to Viśvaṃbhara.
Oṃ, homage to the one whose form is the universe. Oṃ, homage to the one whose appearance is the universe.
Oṃ, homage to the protector of the universe.
Oṃ, salutation to the Soul of the Universe, who is to be served by the universe.
Oṃ, now, salutation to the Universe.
Oṃ, salutation to the Destroyer of the Universe.
Oṃ, homage to Ravi.
Oṃ, homage to Viśvaceṣṭa.
Oṃ, homage to Viśvagamya.
Oṃ, homage to the one worthy of universal meditation.
Oṃ, homage to the bearer of the arts. Oṃ, homage to the leaping monkey.
Oṃ, homage to the best of monkeys. Oṃ, homage to the one known through the Vedas.
Oṃ, homage to the forest-dweller.
Oṃ, homage to the child. Oṃ, homage to the aged. Oṃ, homage to the youth, the reality.
Oṃ, homage to the one accessible through reality. Oṃ, homage to bliss.
Oṃ, homage to the unborn.
Oṃ, homage to the undisturbed son of Añjanā.
Oṃ, homage to him renowned in the village. Oṃ, homage to the upholder of the earth.
Oṃ, salutation to Bhūr-bhuvaḥ-svaḥ Maharloka.
Oṃ, salutation to Janaloka. Oṃ, salutation to Tapoloka.
Oṃ, salutation to the Imperishable. Oṃ, salutation to Him who is reached through the syllable Om, which is Truth. Oṃ, salutation to the Praṇava.
Oṃ, homage to the all-pervading one!
Oṃ, homage to the stainless one! Oṃ, homage to the auspicious one!
Oṃ, homage to the one who is the foundation of Dharma and beloved by Rāma.
Oṃ, homage to the one dear to Phalguna. Oṃ, homage to the one who turned the lord of waters into a mere puddle for a cow's hoofprint.
Oṃ, obeisance to Pūrṇakāma.
Oṃ, obeisance to Dharāpati. Oṃ, obeisance to Rakṣoghna.
Oṃ, homage to the lotus-eyed one. Oṃ, homage to the one who is affectionate toward those who have come for refuge.
Oṃ, homage to the protector who gave life to Jānakī.
Oṃ, homage to the one who takes away life.
Oṃ, homage to the one of perfect being. Oṃ, homage to the one clad in yellow garments, whose radiance is equal to the sun.
Oṃ, homage to the remover of Droṇa, the wielder of the spear, the destroyer of the Rākṣasa Śakti!
Oṃ, homage to the slayer of Akṣa!
Oṃ, homage to the messenger of Rāma!
Oṃ, homage to the one who takes away the life of the Śākinīs.
Oṃ, homage to the one who has struck down his enemies and crushed the pride of the wicked.
Oṃ, homage to the Cause.
Oṃ, homage to Saheta.
Oṃ, homage to Praṃśu.
Oṃ, homage to Viśvabhartṛ, the teacher of the world.
Oṃ, salutation to the protector of the world, the lord of the world. Oṃ, salutation to the sovereign of the world.
Oṃ, salutation to the lord of beings.
Oṃ, obeisance to Hari, the father of the world.
Oṃ, obeisance to the Lord of Śrī. Oṃ, obeisance to the vanquisher of Garuḍa’s pride.
Oṃ, homage to the one whose banner is Pārtha. Oṃ, homage to the son of Vāyu. Oṃ, homage to the one with immeasurable tail.
Oṃ, homage to Amitaprabha.
Oṃ, homage to the tail of Brahmā. Oṃ, homage to the tail of the Supreme Brahmā.
Oṃ, obeisance to Rāma’s beloved.
Oṃ, obeisance to him who is joined by Sugrīva and the others. Oṃ, obeisance to the wise monkey.
Oṃ, salutation to the Lord of Monkeys.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who abides for an eon, the long-lived one, the gracious one.
Oṃ, salutation to the eternally auspicious one.
Oṃ, homage to Sannati.
Oṃ, homage to Sadgati. Oṃ, homage to the bestower of worldly enjoyment and liberation.
Oṃ, homage to the giver of fame!
Oṃ, homage to fame!
Oṃ, homage to the bestower of fame!
Oṃ, obeisance to the ocean-like one. Oṃ, obeisance to the bestower of glory. Oṃ, obeisance to Śiva.
Oṃ, homage to the one who treads upon the ocean.
Oṃ, homage to the god. Oṃ, homage to the destroyer of the fear of saṃsāra.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who binds the ocean, the conqueror of the universe, who is established in all things.
Oṃ, salutation to the maker of Laṅkā. Oṃ, salutation to the Person of Time (Kālapuruṣa).
Oṃ, homage to Laṅkeśagṛhabhañjana. Oṃ, homage to Bhūtāvāsa.
Oṃ, homage to Vāsudeva.
Oṃ, obeisance to Vasu, the Lord of the three worlds. Oṃ, obeisance to the messenger of Śrī Rāma.
Oṃ, obeisance to Kṛṣṇa.
Oṃ, homage to the destroyer of the Laṅkā palace!
Oṃ, homage to Kṛṣṇa!
Oṃ, homage to Kṛṣṇa who is praised!
Oṃ, homage to the Peaceful One. Oṃ, homage to the Bestower of Peace.
Oṃ, homage to the Purifier of the Universe.
Oṃ, salutation to the enjoyer of the universe, the slayer of Māra. Oṃ, salutation to the celibate student who has conquered the senses. Oṃ, salutation to the one who moves upward.
Oṃ, salutation to the one with a tail, the garlanded one, the tailed one, the slayer of Rākṣasas.
Oṃ, salutation to the son of the Wind. Oṃ, salutation to the Hero.
Oṃ, homage to Vīramāra.
Oṃ, homage to Jayaprada. Oṃ, homage to Jaganmaṅgalada.
Oṃ, salutation to Puṇya. Oṃ, salutation to him whose hearing and chanting are meritorious.
Oṃ, salutation to Puṇyakīrti.
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose path is merit, the purifier of the world, for the sake of purification.
Oṃ, salutation to the Lord of Gods.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who has conquered Māra.
Oṃ, salutations to the one who bestows devotion to Rāma. Oṃ, salutations to the meditator and the object of meditation. Oṃ, salutations to Bhaga.
Oṃ, salutation to the witness, the embodiment of consciousness. Oṃ, salutation to the giver of knowledge. Oṃ, salutation to the giver of life.
Oṃ, salutation to Prāṇa. Oṃ, salutation to Jagatprāṇa. Oṃ, salutation to Samīraṇa.
Oṃ, homage to the beloved of Vibhīṣaṇa. Oṃ, homage to the Hero. Oṃ, homage to Pippalāyana, the bestower of spiritual accomplishments.
Oṃ, homage to the Friend. Oṃ, homage to the Abode of the Siddhas.
Oṃ, homage to Time.
Oṃ, homage to Kāla, the devourer, the destroyer! Oṃ, homage to the slayer of the Lord of Laṅkā!
Oṃ, homage to the Lord who dwells [there] and who incinerated Laṅkā!
Oṃ, homage to the one whose eyes are the moon, the sun, and fire.
Oṃ, homage to the fire of time. Oṃ, homage to the one who brings an end to the dissolution of the universe.
Oṃ, homage to Kapila. Oṃ, homage to Kapīśa.
Oṃ, homage to Puṇyarāśi.
Oṃ, homage to the one who resides in the twelve zodiac signs.
Oṃ, homage to the refuge of all.
Oṃ, homage to the immeasurable self who wards off Revatī and the others.
Oṃ, salutation to Lakṣmaṇa, the giver of life to Sītā and the cause of her sustenance.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who is the object of Rāma’s meditation.
Oṃ, salutation to Hṛṣīkeśa.
Oṃ, salutation to the devotee of Viṣṇu.
Oṃ, Jaṭī, Balī; Oṃ, destroyer of the pride of the enemies of the gods, the invoker, the creator, and the destroyer—salutation to the Lord of the Universe.
Oṃ, homage to the protector of the city and the village. Oṃ, homage to the Pure One.
Oṃ, homage to the Awakened One.
Oṃ, salutation to the Uninterrupted. Oṃ, salutation to the Stainless.
Oṃ, salutation to the Non-conceptual.
Oṃ, homage to the one who has transcended the qualities (guṇātīta).
Oṃ, homage to the terrifying one (bhayaṃkara).
Oṃ, homage to Hanuman, the one difficult to propitiate (durārādhya).
Oṃ, salutation to the one who is perfected through austerity.
Oṃ, salutation to Maheśvara.
Oṃ, salutation to the one higher than the highest, who removes the torment arising from the intense grief of Jānakī.
Oṃ, salutation to Vāḍambhya. Oṃ, salutation to the one whose nature is both being and non-being. Oṃ, salutation to the Cause.
Oṃ, salutation to the one beyond primordial nature. Oṃ, salutation to the bestower of fortune. Oṃ, salutation to the stainless one.
Oṃ, homage to the leader who burns Laṅkā at the tail. Oṃ, homage to the one bound at the tail.
Oṃ, homage to the Yātudhāna.
Oṃ, homage to the one dear to the *yātudhāna*s and to enemies. Oṃ, homage to the Lord of Beings who removes calamities. Oṃ, homage to the Lord of the World who bestows the true goal.
Oṃ, homage to the Lord of Monkeys. Oṃ, homage to Wrath.
Oṃ, homage to him whose eyes are bloodshot with rage.
Oṃ, salutations to the remover of anger, the remover of suffering, the bestower of fearlessness and boons to his devotees.
Oṃ, salutations to the Lord of the Universe who is compassionate toward his devotees.
Oṃ, salutations to the one invoked by many.
Oṃ, obeisance to Puraṃdara. Oṃ, obeisance to Agni, Vibhāvasu, and Bhāsvat. Oṃ, obeisance to Yama.
Oṃ, obeisance to Niṣkṛtireva. Oṃ, obeisance to Varuṇa.
Oṃ, obeisance to Vāyugatimān.
Oṃ, obeisance to Vāyu.
Oṃ, obeisance to Kaubera Īśvara. Oṃ, obeisance to Ravi.
Oṃ, homage to Indra.
Oṃ, homage to Kuja.
Oṃ, homage to Saumya.
Oṃ, homage to the Guru.
Oṃ, homage to Kāvya.
Oṃ, homage to Śanaiścara.
Oṃ, homage to Rāhu!
Oṃ, homage to Ketu, the Marut, the Creator, the Sustainer, the Destroyer, born of the Wind! Oṃ, homage to the enemy of the Daityas, who has reduced the enemies of the gods to the size of gnats!
Oṃ, obeisance to Madhusūdana.
Oṃ, obeisance to Kāma. Oṃ, obeisance to Kapardin.
Oṃ, homage to Kāmapāla.
Oṃ, homage to Kapila.
Oṃ, homage to Viśvajīvana.
Oṃ, obeisance to the lotus feet of Bhāgīrathī. Oṃ, obeisance to the one skilled in the construction of the bridge. Oṃ, obeisance to Svāhā, Svadhā, and Havi.
Oṃ, obeisance to Kavya. Oṃ, obeisance to Havyavāha, the illuminator. Oṃ, obeisance to Svaprakāśa, the self-luminous.
Oṃ, homage to the Great Hero. Oṃ, homage to the Swift One. Oṃ, homage to the One of Immeasurable Prowess.
Oṃ, homage to the one possessing the gait of soaring and flying upward. Oṃ, homage to the one who has attained the true goal.
Oṃ, homage to the Supreme Person.
Oṃ, salutation to the Soul of the World, the Source of the World, and the End of the World.
Oṃ, salutation indeed to the Infinite Body. Oṃ, salutation to the Sinless and Stainless One.
Oṃ, homage to Mahānā. Oṃ, homage to Madahaṃkṛti.
Oṃ, homage to Kha.
Oṃ, homage to Vāyu.
Oṃ, homage to Pṛthivī and Āpa. Oṃ, homage to Vahni and the guardian of the quarter (Dikpāla).
Oṃ, homage to the Knower of the Field (Kṣetrajña).
Oṃ, homage to the Guardian of the Field (Kṣetrapāla). Oṃ, homage to the one who turned the ocean into a mere puddle.
Oṃ, homage to the golden one.
Oṃ, homage to the ancient one. Oṃ, homage to the sky-walker.
Oṃ, homage to the one who moves on earth!
Oṃ, homage to Manu!
Oṃ, homage to Hiraṇyagarbha!
Oṃ, salutation to the King of Kings, whose essence is the Sūtra. Oṃ, salutation to the Lord of the People. Oṃ, salutation to the one who is to be known through Vedānta.
Oṃ, salutation to Udgītha. Oṃ, salutation to the one who has reached the further shore of the Vedas and the Vedāṅgas.
Oṃ, salutation to the one residing in every village.
Oṃ, salutation to the one to be accomplished (Sādhya).
Oṃ, salutation to the giver of manifestation, the mine of virtues. Oṃ, salutation to the garlanded with stars, the soul of all beings, the fragrant one.
Oṃ, homage to the wish-fulfilling tree.
Oṃ, homage to the treasure-store of qualities, the wish-granting gem. Oṃ, homage to the unsurpassed Lord of Creatures.
Oṃ, homage to the one of meritorious renown.
Oṃ, homage to the radiant enemy of the cities. Oṃ, homage to the lord of the night.
Oṃ, homage to him who causes the pretas, bhūtas, and piśācas to tremble with the sound of "kili kili. Oṃ, homage to the one who removes the three-fold suffering. Oṃ, homage to the Subtle One.
Oṃ, homage to the pillar!
Oṃ, homage to the all-pervading one!
Oṃ, homage to the Supreme Spirit!
Oṃ, obeisance to the remover of epilepsy.
Oṃ, obeisance to Smṛti, Śruti, Gāthā, and Smṛti for Manu. Oṃ, obeisance to the gateway to heaven.
Oṃ, obeisance to the door of progeny. Oṃ, obeisance to the door of liberation.
Oṃ, obeisance to Kapīśvara.
Oṃ, salutation to the one whose form is sound.
Oṃ, salutation to the Supreme Brahman, the Brahman, the ancient Brahman. Oṃ, salutation to the One.
Oṃ, homage to Naika.
Oṃ, homage to Jana. Oṃ, homage to Śukla.
Oṃ, homage to Svaya.
Oṃ, homage to Jyotirnākula.
Oṃ, homage to Jyoti.
Oṃ, obeisance to the primordial light.
Oṃ, obeisance to the one of sattva-nature. Oṃ, obeisance to the most excellent among those of rajas-nature.

Oṃ, homage to Guṇāśraya.
Oṃ, homage to Guṇamaya.
Oṃ, homage to Bṛhatkāya.
Oṃ, homage to Bṛhadyaśas.
Oṃ, homage to Bṛhaddhanurbṛhatpāda.
Oṃ, obeisance to the Great One.
Oṃ, obeisance to the Head, the one of great sound.
Oṃ, obeisance to the Vast One.
Oṃ, homage to Karṇa.
Oṃ, homage to Bṛhannāsā. Oṃ, homage to Bṛhannetra.
Oṃ, salutation to Bṛhatgalāya. Oṃ, salutation to Bṛhadhyantrāya. Oṃ, salutation to Bṛhatceṣṭāya.
Oṃ, homage to Bṛhatāya. Oṃ, homage to Pucchāya.
Oṃ, homage to Bṛhatkarāya.

Oṃ, salutation to the one of vast power, who grants the fruits of vast desires.
Oṃ, salutations to the Great Lord.
Oṃ, salutations to the one praised by the great world.
Oṃ, salutations to the Seer, the giver of knowledge, the Teacher of the World.
Oṃ, homage to the teacher of the gods.
Oṃ, homage to the speaker of truth, the speaker of Brahman, the bearer of the arts.
Oṃ, homage to the one who travels to the seven netherworlds and dwells on the Malaya mountain.
Oṃ, homage to the one stationed in the northern direction.
Oṃ, homage to the giver of prosperity.
Oṃ, homage to the mastery over divine medicinal herbs.
Oṃ, homage to the sky-goer.
Oṃ, homage to the tree-dweller. Oṃ, homage to the lord of monkeys.
Oṃ, salutation to the Ancient One. Oṃ, salutation to Him who moves through the Vedas.
Oṃ, salutation to the Wise One.
Oṃ, salutation to the Brāhmaṇa.
Oṃ, salutation to the Yogi, who is attainable through yoga. Oṃ, salutation to the one higher than the highest.
Oṃ, salutation to the one without beginning or end.
Oṃ, salutation to Vyāsa.
Oṃ, salutation to Vaikuṇṭha.
Oṃ, homage to the Lord of the Earth! Oṃ, homage to Parājita!
Oṃ, homage to Jitārāti!
Oṃ, homage to Sadānanda.
Oṃ, homage to Īśitā. Oṃ, homage to Gopāla.
Oṃ, obeisance to Gopati, the protector, for the sake of the ritual action (kalaya).
Oṃ, obeisance to Kāla. Oṃ, obeisance to the one higher than the highest.

Oṃ, homage to the Pure One!
Oṃ, homage to the Awakened One!
Oṃ, homage to the Ever-Liberated One!
Oṃ, homage to the King of Devotees. Oṃ, homage to the Bestower of Victory.
Oṃ, homage to the Dissolution.
Oṃ, homage to Amitamāyā.
Oṃ, homage to Māyātīta.
Oṃ, homage to Vimatsara.
Oṃ, homage to the protection born of illusion!
Oṃ, homage to the world created by illusion!
Oṃ, homage to that which has illusion as its support!
Oṃ, homage to the stainless one. Oṃ, homage to the one who deceives through illusion. Oṃ, homage to bliss.
Oṃ, homage to the blissful one who bestows bliss.
Oṃ, homage to the Nāga. Oṃ, homage to him who was praised by Maheśa.
Oṃ, homage to Maheśvara. Oṃ, homage to Satyasaṃdha.
Oṃ, homage to Śarabha.
Oṃ, homage to the purifier of the Kali age. Oṃ, homage to taste.
Oṃ, homage to the knower of taste.
Oṃ, salutation to Sammana-stapacakṣu. Oṃ, salutation to Bhairava. Oṃ, salutation to Ghrāṇa.
Oṃ, homage to fragrance. Oṃ, homage to the sense of touch.
Oṃ, homage to tangibility.

Oṃ, salutation to the one who is fond of the worship of Vaikuṇṭha.
Oṃ, salutation to Girīśa. Oṃ, salutation to the beloved of Girijā.
Oṃ, salutation to Dūrvāsas.
Oṃ, salutation to Kavi Aṅgiras.
Oṃ, salutation to Bhṛgu Vasiṣṭha.
Oṃ, salutation to Yavana Tumburu Nārada.
Oṃ, homage to the Immaculate One. Oṃ, homage to the Field of the Universe. Oṃ, homage to the Seed of the Universe.
Oṃ, homage to Viśvanetra.
Oṃ, homage to Viśvaga. Oṃ, homage to Yājaka.
Oṃ, obeisance to the sacrificer.
Oṃ, obeisance to Pāvaka. Oṃ, obeisance likewise to the Pitṛs.
Oṃ, homage to Śraddhābuddhi.
Oṃ, homage to the mantra Kṣamātandrā. Oṃ, homage to Mantrayuta.
Oṃ, homage to Svara.
Oṃ, homage to Rājendra. Oṃ, homage to Bhūpati, the wearer of a garland of skulls, the charioteer of saṃsāra.
Oṃ, homage to the Eternal One. Oṃ, homage to Him whose desires are completely fulfilled. Oṃ, homage to the supreme granter of the wishes of His devotees.
Oṃ, homage to Gaṇapā. Oṃ, homage to Kīśapā.
Oṃ, homage to Māruta, the brother, the father, and the mother.
Oṃ, obeisance to the Puruṣa of a thousand heads. Oṃ, obeisance to the one of a thousand eyes. Oṃ, obeisance to the one of a thousand feet.
Oṃ, homage to Kāmajit.
Oṃ, homage to Kāmadahana.
Oṃ, homage to Kāma.
Oṃ, salutation to the bestower of desired fruits.
Oṃ, salutation to the one who removes the mudrās and slays the rākṣasas. Oṃ, salutation to the remover of the earth’s burden.
Oṃ, salutation to Bala. Oṃ, salutation to the one who fights with claws and fangs. Oṃ, salutation to the devotee of Viṣṇu.
Oṃ, homage to the bestower of fearlessness and boons. Oṃ, homage to the destroyer of pride and the giver of pride. Oṃ, homage to the haughty one.

Oṃ, homage to the giver of great purpose! Oṃ, homage to the one of great form!
Oṃ, homage to the great yogin, the one of great splendor and great radiance!
Oṃ, homage to the one of great action and great sound. Oṃ, homage to the one of the great mantra. Oṃ, homage to the one of great intelligence.
Oṃ, homage to the one of great resolve. Oṃ, homage to the one who is most noble.
Oṃ, homage to the one whose nature is Mahādeva.
Oṃ, homage to Vibhava.
Oṃ, homage to Rudrakarmākṛtakarman Ratnanābha.
Oṃ, homage to Kṛtāgama.
Oṃ, homage to the leaper over the ocean. Oṃ, homage to the lion.
Oṃ, homage to the eternal one.
Oṃ, homage to Dharmā. Oṃ, homage to Pramodana.
Oṃ, homage to Jitāmitra.

Oṃ, salutations to Bhūridakṣiṇa.
Oṃ, salutations to Siddhārtha.

Oṃ, homage to the Hero!
Oṃ, homage to the one whose vast mandala consists of the seven continents!
Oṃ, homage to the bestower of the happiness of the sevenfold kingdom!

Oṃ, homage to Saptacchanda. Oṃ, homage to Nidhi. Oṃ, homage to Saptacchanda.

Oṃ, salutation to Medhāvī, the giver of fame.
Oṃ, salutation to Śokahārī, the destroyer of misfortune. Oṃ, salutation to the one who brings all under control.
Oṃ, salutation to the destroyer of defects in the womb. Oṃ, salutation to the bestower of sons and grandsons.

Oṃ, homage to Parābhicāraśamanā. Oṃ, homage to Dava.
